skill.name: seedance-v2
skill.description: Guides use of ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro on RunComfy for short cinematic video generation, including reference media limits, prompt guidance, CLI commands, and privacy boundaries.
skill.summary: Generate short Seedance 2.0 Pro videos through the RunComfy CLI with clear input guidance.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: Most static command detections are Markdown backticks, schema examples, or prompt examples. Confirmed risks are the RunComfy and npm commands, the documented outbound Model API call, and a repository mismatch in the install instructions. No prompt injection attempt or hidden data exfiltration was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Update the GitHub link and npx install command to the audited runcomfy-com source, or clearly document and audit the agentspace-so source.
Avoid recommending global community installs, or require users to review the repository and pin a trusted version before installing.

remediation.issue: Local CLI execution with generated downloads
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running runcomfy commands, and validate output directories before downloading generated files.
Tell users that prompts and reference media are sent to RunComfy, and ask for consent before submitting sensitive content.

content.value_statement: Short video production needs clear model settings, reference media limits, and safe RunComfy commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Seedance 2.0 Pro prompts and CLI inputs.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Seedance 2.0 Pro versus HappyHorse, Wan, Kling, or LTX.
Documents RunComfy CLI prerequisites, login options, and command examples.
Defines prompt, image_url, video_url, audio_url, aspect_ratio, duration, resolution, generate_audio, and seed inputs.
Provides prompt guidance for identity references, camera motion, audio tone, and lip-sync.
Lists endpoint limits for duration, resolution, reference videos, and reference audio.
Documents exit codes and links to RunComfy CLI troubleshooting.
limitations: Requires an installed RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Submits prompts and media references to the RunComfy Model API.
Supports only 4 to 15 second clips and up to 720p resolution.
Does not guarantee perfect lip-sync or identity preservation.

use_cases.title: Create Dialogue Ads
use_cases.description: Generate short vertical spokesperson clips with reference images, guided audio tone, and clear duration settings.

use_cases.title: Prototype Cinematic Shots
use_cases.description: Turn shot descriptions, scene references, and motion notes into concise RunComfy prompts for previs work.

use_cases.title: Test Brand Video Variants
use_cases.description: Use fixed seeds, aspect ratios, and reference media to compare short-form video variants.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Text-Only Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with no reference media.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 5 second Seedance 2.0 Pro clip about [scene]. Use [aspect ratio], [camera motion], and [audio mood].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Lip-Synced Ad
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with one character image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my character image to make an 8 second vertical ad. The speaker says [message] in a [tone] voice.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Modal References
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with image, video, and audio references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Seedance prompt using my image, scene video, and audio reference. Keep identity stable and describe only action, lighting, and camera.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Models Before Running
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced routing decision before CLI execution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Seedance 2.0 Pro with HappyHorse, Wan, Kling, and LTX for this request: [goal]. Recommend the best route and explain why.

output_examples.input: A cafe owner wants a short vertical video of a barista speaking about a seasonal drink.
output_examples.output: Recommended Seedance 2.0 Pro with 9:16 framing, 8 second duration, one character image, warm dialogue tone, and generate_audio enabled.

output_examples.input: A film team wants a quick previs shot using a location video and a voice reference.
output_examples.output: Prepared a multi-modal prompt that separates stable references from evolving action, camera movement, lighting, and audio direction.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a 30 second branded clip from one prompt.
output_examples.output: Explained the 15 second endpoint limit and suggested splitting the concept into shorter segments.

best_practices: Put stable identity and brand assets in image references instead of long text descriptions.
Keep prompts focused on action, camera, lighting, mood, and audio tone.
Confirm RunComfy commands and output directories before executing the CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not mix conflicting visual styles across reference media.
Do not request clips longer than the endpoint limit.
Do not submit sensitive faces, voices, or brand assets without permission.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create short Seedance 2.0 Pro videos through RunComfy with text, image, video, and audio references.

faq.question: Does it run locally?
faq.answer: It uses a local RunComfy CLI, but generation runs through the RunComfy Model API.

faq.question: What media references are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio references for this endpoint.

faq.question: Can it make long videos?
faq.answer: No. The documented endpoint supports 4 to 15 second clips.

faq.question: Can it create lip-synced speech?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to prompt for in-pass audio and natural lip-sync.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review the CLI command, output directory, RunComfy account status, and any sensitive media before submission.
